title: Ibn Kathir
snippet: simply as Ibn Kathir, was an Arab Islamic exegete, historian and scholar. An expert on tafsir (Quranic exegesis), tarikh (history) and fiqh (Islamic jurisprudence)

title: Ubadah ibn al-Samit
snippet: career as a qadi in the Holy Land. In later years he assisted Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan, the governor of Syria and future founder of the Umayyad Caliphate
